verdict.summary: The change replaces the lossy run-level-success bound with a job-level classification that requires positive full-matrix shard coverage, rejects genuine failures and unverified shards, and clearly reports stale/cold-start fallback behavior. The tests exercise the load-bearing positive and negative cases through both the pure classifier and the real command-construction path, including cancelled aggregate runs with successful shards, failure/cancellation rejection, newest valid-bound selection, horizon fallback, and report-only mode. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test defect is apparent in the diff.
